RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement ("Lease") is made on March 1, 2026, between Harbor Lane Properties LLC ("Landlord") and Dana Whitfield ("Tenant"). All names and addresses in this Lease are fictional.

1. Premises. Landlord leases to Tenant, and Tenant leases from Landlord, the residential apartment located at 418 Willow Court, Unit 3B, Easton, together with one assigned parking space (the "Premises"). The Premises shall be used only as a private residence for Tenant and the occupants listed in this Lease.

2. Term. The term of this Lease begins on April 1, 2026 and ends on March 31, 2027. If Tenant remains in possession of the Premises after the term ends without a new written lease, the tenancy shall continue month to month on the same terms, except that rent shall increase by ten percent.

3. Rent. Tenant shall pay Landlord monthly rent of $1,850, due in advance on the first day of each month. Rent paid after the fifth day of the month incurs a late fee of $95. Landlord may increase the rent on renewal by giving Tenant sixty days' written notice.

4. Security Deposit. On signing this Lease, Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $3,700. Landlord may apply the security deposit to unpaid rent, cleaning, and repair of any damage to the Premises beyond normal wear and tear. Landlord shall return the balance of the security deposit within thirty days after Tenant vacates the Premises and returns all keys.

5. Utilities. Tenant is responsible for electricity, gas, internet, and water charges for the Premises. Landlord pays for trash collection and common-area lighting.

6. Maintenance and Repairs. Tenant shall keep the Premises clean and in good condition and shall promptly notify Landlord of any needed repairs. Landlord shall maintain the roof, plumbing, heating, and electrical systems. Tenant shall pay for any repair caused by the negligence of Tenant or Tenant's guests.

7. Entry by Landlord. Landlord may enter the Premises to inspect, make repairs, or show the unit to prospective tenants or buyers on twenty-four hours' notice, and at any time without notice in an emergency.

8. Pets and Smoking. No pets are allowed on the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent. Smoking is prohibited anywhere on the Premises.

9. Subletting. Tenant shall not sublet the Premises or assign this Lease without Landlord's prior written consent.

10. Termination. Either party may end the tenancy at the end of the term by giving the other party sixty days' written notice. If Tenant breaks the Lease early, Tenant remains liable for rent until the Premises are re-let or the term ends, whichever comes first.

11. Default. If Tenant fails to pay rent when due or breaches any other term of this Lease, Landlord may terminate the tenancy and recover possession of the Premises as permitted by law.

12. Governing Law. This Lease is governed by the landlord and tenant laws of the state in which the Premises are located.

Landlord: Harbor Lane Properties LLC, by its manager, Paul Reyes
Tenant: Dana Whitfield
